wrap_model_with_fsdp: wrap a PyTorch nn.Module with MMFullyShardedDataParallel for sharded data parallel training
run_train_step: run a training step with MMFullyShardedDataParallel that performs forward, backward, and parameter update
run_val_step: run a validation step with MMFullyShardedDataParallel to get inference predictions on data
run_test_step: run a test step with MMFullyShardedDataParallel to get inference predictions on test data
get_optim_state_dict: get the optimizer state dict from an FSDP-wrapped model using optim_state_dict static method
